variants.prompt: On a deserted beach at dawn, with the rising sun casting a warm, cinematic light, Hazel kneels in the sand, looking back over her shoulder at the photographer. She wears a tiny string bikini and a sheer cover-up, her wind-blown hair framing her face. One hand rests on her hip, the other on her knee, as she presents her toned, sun-kissed body in a provocative, yet innocent, pose, as if inviting the viewer to join her in this private, serene moment.
